capabilities: Render each matching note as an editable form of its properties
Edit text, list, checkbox, number, and date properties into frontmatter
Autocomplete text and list fields from vault values
Show file and formula properties as read-only values
Paginate large collections with 25, 50, or 100 notes per page
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later with the Bases core plugin enabled. The repository includes a demo vault with a configured base and sample notes. Runs locally with no network requests. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: BaseForm adds an editable Form view to Obsidian Bases.
problem: Bases views display properties in a table or cards, but there is no built-in way to edit a note's properties through a form interface.
summary: Adds an editable Form view to Obsidian Bases that renders each matching note as a form for editing its properties.
